summary: Verses AI Inc. (CBOE:VERS, OTCQB:VRSSD) filed an 8-K on July 2, 2026 reporting the immediate resignations of CFO James Christodoulou (June 26) and Interim CEO David Scott (June 30), who remains a director. The departures align with the previously announced discontinuation of AI R&D activities. The company is pursuing financing and strategic opportunities to maximize shareholder value but cautions there is no assurance of obtaining a transaction to continue operations. No terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for further strategic updates or potential liquidation risk.
